powers.title: Call Faerie Guardian
powers.description: A bright light answers your call and heralds the faerie guardian's arrival. The diminutive warrior flutters near your foe while worrying it with feints and strikes.
rows: Effect: You conjure a faerie guardian in an unoccupied square within range. The faerie lasts until the end of the encounter or until you dismiss it as a minor action. As a minor action, you can move the faerie up to 5 squares.
Whenever you use your Nature's Wrath class feature, one enemy adjacent to your faerie guardian also becomes marked by you until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Erupting Font
powers.description: As you shake off a debilitating condition, your primal might raises your foes' ire.
rows: Trigger: You succeed on the saving throw granted by your Font of Life class feature
Target: Each enemy in the burst
Effect: You mark each target until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Eyes of the Hawk
powers.description: You call on the primal energy in your blood, allowing you to find your foes like a keen-eyed hawk.
rows: Effect: You make a Perception check with a +10 power bonus.

powers.title: Guardian Thorns
powers.description: You surround your friend with ghostly thorns that impale any enemy that attacks him or her.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: Until the end of your next turn, when any enemy marked by you hits or misses the target, that enemy takes 5 damage.

powers.title: Mountain Lion Step
powers.description: Like an agile mountain lion, you leap across difficult terrain with ease.
rows: Effect: You ignore difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.

powers.title: Nature's Abundance
powers.description: Plants burst into life around you. They sway back and forth to shield your allies, parting to allow attacks against your foes.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of plants that lasts until the end of the encounter. You and your allies have cover while within the zone.

powers.title: Triumphant Vigor
powers.description: One victory gives you strength to achieve the next.
rows: Requirement: You must have reduced an enemy to 0 hit points during this turn.
Effect: You regain hit points equal to 1d6 + your Wisdom + your Constitution.

powers.title: Warden's Tempest
powers.description: Your wrath is a storm, and an enemy that feels it is moved against its will.
rows: Target: One enemy marked by you
Effect: You slide the target 1 square.

powers.title: Warding Touch
powers.description: You increase your vulnerability in combat to shore up an ally's defense.
rows: Target: One ally

Effect: Until the end of your next turn, you take a penalty to AC equal to your Constitution, and the target gains a power bonus to AC equal to your Constitution. If the target has any creatures marked, those marks end, and if the target marks a creature, this effect ends.

powers.title: Bear's Endurance
powers.description: Drawing on the boundless endurance of a bear, you regain a measure of your vitality.
rows: Trigger: You drop to 0 hit points or fewer
Effect: You regain hit points as if you had spent a healing surge.

powers.title: Earthguard
powers.description: Primal power from the earth fortifies your body and mind.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, you gain a +1 power bonus to all defenses.

powers.title: Fey Congress
powers.description: Tiny glowing fey folk flit and caper through the air around you. Their movements make it difficult for distant enemies to see you.
rows: Effect: The burst becomes a zone that lasts until the end of your next turn. Enemies treat the zone as lightly obscured terrain.
Sustain Minor: The zone persists.

powers.title: Returning the Gift
powers.description: You draw on your strength to return the aid given to you by an ally.
rows: Trigger: An ally targets you with a power that does not include that ally as a target
Effect: The ally also becomes a target of the power.

powers.title: Sea Stride
powers.description: You draw on the strength of flowing water to glide through the waves with ease.
rows: Effect: You gain a swim speed equal to your speed until the end of your turn.

powers.title: Soothing Wind
powers.description: Your primal might allows you to regain additional vigor in the heat of combat.
rows: Effect: You use your second wind and regain 2d6 additional hit points.

powers.title: Treacherous Ice
powers.description: Ice forms on the ground around you as you fight, limiting your foes' movement.
rows: Effect: Until the stance ends, enemies can't shift into or out of squares adjacent to you.

powers.title: Wilding Strength
powers.description: Your devastating attacks are fueled by a surge of primal fury.
rows: Effect: Until the end of your next turn, whenever you make an attack roll or a damage roll with a weapon attack, roll a d6 and add it as a power bonus to the roll.

powers.title: Windborne Step
powers.description: A sudden gust of wind whips around you, lifting you into the fray.
rows: Effect: You shift 2 squares. You ignore difficult terrain during the shift.

powers.title: Wrathful Mastery
powers.description: The pain you endure increases the strength of your later attack.
rows: Trigger: An enemy's attack hits you and damages you

Effect: You take extra damage from the triggering attack equal to one-half your level. The next time you attack any enemy marked by you before the end of the encounter, you gain a bonus equal to your Constitution to the attack roll and the damage roll.

powers.title: Bond of Shared Pain
powers.description: The bond you share with your companions lets you take the injury meant for an ally.
rows: Trigger: An ally within 2 squares of you takes damage from an attack
Target: The triggering ally in the burst
Effect: You take the damage from the attack, instead of the target, but the target takes any other effect caused by the attack.

powers.title: Earthstride
powers.description: You meld into the ground and then emerge a short distance away.
rows: Effect: You teleport a number of squares equal to your Constitution.

powers.title: Elemental Warding (Warden)
powers.description: You summon primal spirits to protect you and your allies from elemental power.
rows: Target: You and each ally in the burst
Effect: Choose cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Until the end of your next turn, each target gains resistance to that damage type equal to one-half your level.

powers.title: Entangling Shield
powers.description: Your shield sprouts vines that grab at your enemy.
rows: Requirement: You must be wielding a shield.
Trigger: You are hit with a melee attack.
Target: The triggering creature

Effect: You gain a +4 bonus to the defense targeted by the triggering attack until the end of your next turn. If the triggering attack misses, the target is immobilized until the end of your next turn, or until you move away from the creature, whichever comes first.

powers.title: Guardian's Attack
powers.description: Your guardian form grants you even greater potency in combat.
rows: Requirement: You must be in a guardian form and must have used that form's attack during this encounter.
Effect: You regain the use of the guardian form's attack.

powers.title: Returning Strength
powers.description: Just as primal energy grants life to the world, it lends strength and endurance to you.
rows: Effect: You spend a healing surge and regain additional hit points equal to your Strength.

powers.title: Shared Font of Life
powers.description: Primal bonds connect you and an ally, allowing you to share your own resilience.
rows: Trigger: You start your turn
Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: The target can make a saving throw, and you can't use your Font of Life class feature during this turn.

powers.title: Shield of Stone
powers.description: Earth carries your ally to safety while stone forms a protective barrier around him or her.
rows: Target: One ally in the burst
Effect: You slide the target 5 squares. Until the end of your next turn, the target gains resist 5 to all damage and a +2 power bonus to all defenses.

powers.title: Spiritual Rejuvenation
powers.description: By drawing on your primal strength, you tap additional reserves of vitality.
rows: Requirement: You must have used your second wind during this encounter.
Effect: You regain the use of your second wind.

powers.title: Sylvan Trickery
powers.description: Your faerie allies cloak you in fey magic to hide you and speed you away.
rows: Target: You or one ally
Effect: The target becomes invisible until the end of his or her next turn or until he or she makes an attack. When the invisibility ends, the target can teleport up to 3 squares.

powers.title: Warding Vines
powers.description: Spectral vines bloom around you to shield you and your allies.
rows: Effect: The burst creates a zone of protective vines that lasts until the end of the encounter. While within the zone, you and your allies gain resistance to all damage equal to your Constitution.
